name: Bountiful Forage
summary: Cindersap Forest and the beach fill up with more wild forage, always the same seasonal finds as before.
logoPrompt: A small woven wicker basket overflowing with wild forage: a yellow dandelion, a mushroom, a red berry sprig and a striped clam shell

cover.tagline: More to find in the forest and on the beach.

description: **Bountiful Forage lets more wild forage appear in Cindersap Forest and on the beach, so a walk there pays off more often.**
- The forage limit of both maps rises from 6 to 9 items with the default setting.
- More spawn attempts each night, so the extra forage shows up sooner.
- Choose +25 %, +50 % (default) or +100 % in the config, in English or German.
- Only the items the base game already spawns there, in their own seasons: no new items, no new places.
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher, then unzip the file into your `Mods` folder. Visit the forest and the beach as usual.
- Needs SMAPI and Content Patcher 2.9.0 or newer. Made for Stardew Valley 1.6.
- Built carefully from the documented formats of Stardew Valley 1.6 and Content Patcher. Prices, seasons and item chances stay as they are.
- Gatherer and Botanist work on the extra forage like on any other. Tide pool items and spring onions are not changed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
